name: Derek Haskell Jr.
office: City of Carson, Member of the City Council, 2nd District

items.text: Derek Haskell Jr. is executive director of the C3 Foundation. His campaign describes experience in mental health, disaster recovery after Hurricane Katrina, and work with LAUSD students and Carson Recreation and Parks. His campaign says he built the California Youth Medical Training Program and California Prison Arts Initiative.

sentences.text: Derek Haskell Jr. is executive director of the C3 Foundation.
His campaign describes experience in mental health, disaster recovery after Hurricane Katrina, and work with LAUSD students and Carson Recreation and Parks.
His campaign says he built the California Youth Medical Training Program and California Prison Arts Initiative.

items.text: He told the Southern California News Group that one of his top priorities would be investing in youth, including mentorship, career pathways, sports and civic engagement. His campaign also lists safe and clean neighborhoods, workforce and economic development, practical homelessness and housing solutions, and transparent city government as goals.
